be cross verb

also cross, in a huff, angry, tantrum

classical

Cic.

stomachor, stomachārī

verb, first conjugation, deponent

be cross, in a huff

Examples

  • nihil fēcit quod suscēnseās

    he did nothing for you to be cross aboutTraupman 93; Ter., Cic.

  • Quid stomachāris, mī fīlī?

    What are you cross about, my boy?composed

Other words

  • suscēnseō, suscēnsēre — be cross with

    verb, second conjugation · also used · classical · Traupman 93; Ter.; Cic.

    + dat.

See also grumpy, irritable, lose one’s temper, happy.
